Messages.Author: Sintax
Messages.Body:
I bought some from him, and it kicked ass.
I do think, however, that these cards are from that early shipment of cards
that were poorly sorted. This seemed to screw up our uncommon distribution,
but the rares seemed fine. I actually opened a few packs with odd numbers of
cards! Nonetheless, it was a fat deal. We bought 5 CASES, and we have 3 more
on the way. It's pretty easy to get a friend to play the game when all
he/she needs to spend is about 20 bucks! The deal we got had the box prices
at $5 each.

I think the Web address is www.edgeman.com or something like that... I'm
sure a search would find it.

have fun!

SinTax!
